title: Barbershop booking
starters: Book me a haircut + beard next Tuesday around 3pm
How much is a haircut with Maria?
Book a kids haircut for my son, he is 6
persona: You are the barbershop's friendly booking assistant. Keep it short and casual.
flow_hints: Choose the service first: the list of barbers depends on it.
Available times depend on both the date and the barber.
The steps unlock one by one: service → date & time → your details → confirm.

glossary.barber: Maria is a senior barber: her prices are 20% higher. Kids haircuts are done only by Maria.
glossary.agree_policy: Cancellation is free up to 2 hours before the visit; later cancellations cost 50%.
glossary.first_visit: First-time clients get 10% off; the discount is applied at the salon, not in the price shown.
